question: Qutub Minar was built in which century?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thirteenth.**__

 
• The Qutub Minar, built in the Thirteenth century, is a **238-foot-high tapering tower divided into five storeys**. 
 
• The Minar is a mix of polygonal and circular shapes.
 
• It is largely built of red and buff sandstone with some use of marble in the upper storeys.
 
• It is characterized by highly decorated balconies and bands of inscriptions intertwined with foliated designs.
 
• **Qutb al-Din Aibak** started the construction of **Qutub Minar **which was completed by **Iltutmish**.
